title: arenaria viscidula
intro: Arenaria viscidula, commonly known as Sticky Mouse-ear or Sticky Chickweed, is a flowering plant native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and is often used to treat skin conditions, wounds, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Arenaria viscidula include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and heal damaged skin and mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
